title: Ground Sprint Burst and Construct Collision Guard
description:
Purpose: Layer sprint bursts over builtin sliding locomotion and enforce pushback against player-placed constructs/barriers to prevent stepping through. Also ensure snap/smooth turn selection from CLocomotionSettings is respected.

Behaviour:
- Movement: builtin.locomotion.slide.* provides baseline motion. This mechanic listens for Left Thumbstick Click to apply a temporary speed multiplier (sprint) while grounded. Parameters:
  - params.value("sprint_multiplier", 1.5)
  - params.value("sprint_rise_tau_s", 0.08) // ease-in
  - params.value("sprint_fall_tau_s", 0.12) // ease-out
  - params.value("sprint_max_duration_s", 2.0) // cap per hold
  - params.value("sprint_cooldown_s", 1.0)
- Comfort vignette: when sprint_factor > 1.0, publish vignette_intensity = base + k*(sprint_factor-1) if CLocomotionSettings.vignette_enabled.
- Turning: If CLocomotionSettings.smooth_turn_enabled, apply yaw at rate smooth_turn_rate_dps when Right Thumbstick X deflects, otherwise ensure builtin.locomotion.snap_turn is enabled and consumes stick snaps.
- Collision guard: Continuously raycast/sweep a capsule from current to predicted next ground position; if colliding with entities tagged CTag{ "construct_barrier" | "construct_platform" | "placed_construct" }, clamp movement to contact plane and apply gentle pushback/slide along surface. Also prevent stepping through thin barriers by requiring penetration_resolution < params.value("max_penetration_m", 0.02).
- Deadzones: Honor circular deadzones on both sticks per params.

Quest 3 bindings (params_json):
- params.value("left_stick_click_is_sprint", true)
- params.value("snap_turn_fallback_deg", 45.0) // used if CLocomotionSettings missing
- params.value("right_stick_deadzone", 0.2)

Components read/write:
- Reads CMechanicBinding for inputs, CTransform + CPhysics for player body, CTag on constructs, CLocomotionSettings (from locomotion_settings_menu).
- Writes CPhysics.velocity when applying sprint scaling; writes a transient CSprintState on player with fields: active, time_in_s, cooldown_remaining_s.

Comfort/safety:
- Clamp net ground speed to params.value("max_speed_mps", 3.5) even during sprint to prevent extreme vection.
- Disable sprint when in hover or flight (detected via CHoverState/CFlightState flags from hover_mode_mechanic/flight_mode_mechanic).

Acceptance hooks:
- test_ground_movement_turning: With Left Thumbstick, the player walks; Left Thumbstick Click enables sprint burst with optional vignette; Right Thumbstick produces snap or smooth turn per settings. Attempting to push into a barrier results in slide-along and gentle pushback; no clipping.

Integration points:
- Relies on builtin.locomotion.slide.head_relative or controller_relative being active.
- Reads CLocomotionSettings from locomotion_settings_menu.

Assets/scenes: Global in ground-capable scenes.

Suggested file split: ground_sprint_collision_guard_register.cpp, ground_sprint.cpp, collision_guard.cpp
